movement_not_scored_reason: Movement is not scored because independently retrained AutoEncoders define new latent coordinate systems incompatible with the frozen Condition 1 Residual-GRU.

fallacy_scan_11_of_11.simpsons_paradox: Per-bearing LOBO results; no pooled correlation.
fallacy_scan_11_of_11.ecological_fallacy: Bearing is the independent evaluation unit.
fallacy_scan_11_of_11.berkson_bias: Laboratory run-to-failure selection limits deployment generalization.
fallacy_scan_11_of_11.base_rate_neglect: No event classification is performed in Arm B.
fallacy_scan_11_of_11.look_elsewhere_effect: Folds, epochs, seed and metrics were preregistered.
fallacy_scan_11_of_11.researcher_degrees_of_freedom: Fixed five epochs; held-out bearing is not used for checkpoint selection.
fallacy_scan_11_of_11.correlation_causation: Lifetime correlation is not physical damage causation.
fallacy_scan_11_of_11.reverse_causality: Temporal order is preserved without causal inference.
